speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are in between your two duties. The loaf has not heard of either of them. It is a finger short.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the length of it. Threepence, and I am out again at two. I am in the gentlemen.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is still on the stair. Your letter is still on the desk. I have dusted round both.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave both. Nothing on that desk goes out. I have not finished being abroad today.
